What remains true and is what the dispatch does: `maskComments` re-implements the module's exported `maskComments` byte-for-byte and should be the import; `maskCode` (comments + literals blanked) has NO shared export yet — the same composition now lives privately in `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:2409` and lands a third time in `measure-self-test-floor.mjs` (PR #15580, armed). Hoisting it into `js-comment-mask.mjs` touches a file two live PRs mirror (#15534's `.d.mts`, #15580), so that is a follow-up card, filed by the dev with the three sites named, not this PR.
